# BAD-008 — Make collab create atomic, so a failed stamp cannot leak an unreachable open room

## Brief
From BadTakes TODO.md item 43 (added 2026-08-26), still open as of 2026-09-14.

Repro (production, 2026-08-26): every collab create 500'd on collabs_scene_cast_check (fixed in #171), and each failure still left an open room behind. private.create_collab inserts and commits the row, and server/supabase/functions/collab/index.ts stamps visibility, character_count and scene_cast in a separate UPDATE afterwards (the "Stamped after the fact" comment near line 391, still there today). When that UPDATE throws, the room survives and the caller gets an error. Ten failures filled every MAX_OPEN_COLLABS slot and hosting was refused on every scene until the rows were closed by hand. The orphan also holds collabs_one_hosted_per_scene, so the scene answers already_hosting for 24h (sweepExpired's IDLE_TTL_MS), which the client maps onto the fallback panel with no explanation.

Why the app cannot recover: main.js writes the scene.json pin only after collab:create returns ok, so an orphan has no pin and is unreachable from the desktop UI.

Fix direction:
- Make create atomic: stamp the three columns inside create_collab's transaction (or widen its signature), so a stamping failure rolls the room back. 0026's note explains why they were kept out (a row lock on the licence while it decides the paid check and open-collab cap), so widen it with care.
- Cheaper interim: close the room just minted when the stamp throws, as uploadSceneForCollab already does for an upload failure. Does not cover a crash between the two.
- Reconcile: the endpoint already has a 'mine' mode and web/collabweb.js renderMyCollabs lists a member's rooms, but it filters to active or wrapped phases. Check whether an orphan shows there, and give the desktop the same host-side list so an unpinned room is visible and cancellable.
- Open question from the incident: three rooms whose create and stamp both succeeded were also invisible, so there may be a second orphan path (a failed scene upload whose close or unpin did not land). Confirm before calling this fixed.

Verification: the BadTakes server-changes skill; test/server/functions.test.mjs against a local stack (podman, DOCKER_HOST), and the Server integration CI check is authoritative. Backend deploys from CI on merge, never from a laptop.

## Size, persona and model decision
One engineer, no children: a migration widening private.create_collab plus the collab function's create path, the reconcile check and the second-orphan investigation are one tightly coupled change. Model fable over opus's default: a migration that changes the locking transaction around the licence row and the open-collab cap on production data is expensive if wrong.
